item.title: Trump administration mails $500 ACA refund checks
item.description: The Trump administration began mailing $500 Affordable Care Act checks this week to enrollees who were allegedly overcharged for coverage.

item.title: Jobs report to gauge September hiring resilience
item.description: The jobs report will offer a measure of the economy amid an inflation surge.

item.title: Patient dies by suicide after insurance delay for medicine
item.description: Kenney Blewett of Kyle, Texas, died by suicide in June, hours after a flare-up related to chronic obstructive pulmonary disease.

item.title: Trump says Iran war will end quickly as troops deploy
item.description: About 9,000 more U.S. forces are heading to the Middle East as Trump vows the war will end right after the election, if not sooner.
